watt.definition:
n. a unit of power equal to 1 joule per second; the power dissipated by a current of 1 ampere flowing across a resistance of 1 ohm
n. Scottish engineer and inventor whose improvements in the steam engine led to its wide use in industry (1736-1819)
watt.translation:
n. 瓦(特)
[化] 瓦; 瓦特

watt-hour.definition: n. a unit of energy equal to the power of one watt operating for one hour
watt-hour.translation:
n. 瓦(特小)时
[电] 瓦特小时

watt-hour constant of a meter.translation: [电] 仪表的瓦特小时常数

wattage.definition: n the product of voltage and current
wattage.translation:
n. 瓦(特)数
[医] 瓦特数

wattages.definition: n. the product of voltage and current

watteau.translation: a. 华托式的(指法国画家华托作品中的女子服装式样的)

watteaus.definition:
plural of Watteau
n French painter (1684-1721)
watteaus.translation: (Watteau 的复数) adj.华托式的(指法国画家华托作品中的女子服装式样的)

watter.translation: 瓦消耗量, 瓦消耗者

watters.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 沃特斯取自父名，来源于Water↑1，含义是“沃特之子”(son of Water)

wattful.translation: 有功的, 与电压同相的

wattle.definition:
n. a fleshy wrinkled and often brightly colored fold of skin hanging from the neck or throat of certain birds (chickens and turkeys) or lizards
n. framework consisting of stakes interwoven with branches to form a fence
n. any of various Australasian trees yielding slender poles suitable for wattle
wattle.translation:
n. 枝条构架, 编条, 枝条, 板条, 肉垂, 鱼须
a. 由编条做成的, 板条的
vt. 用编条做成

wattlebird.definition:
n. Any one of several species of honey eaters belonging to
   Anthochaera and allied genera of the family Meliphagidae. These birds
   usually have a large and conspicuous wattle of naked skin hanging down
   below each ear. They are natives of Australia and adjacent islands.
n. The Australian brush turkey.
wattlebird.translation: n. [鸟](澳洲产)食蜜雀,垂耳鸦

wattled.definition:
v build of or with wattle
v interlace to form wattle
wattled.translation: a. 由枝条编筑的, 有肉垂的

wattles.definition:
n a fleshy wrinkled and often brightly colored fold of skin hanging from the neck or throat of certain birds (chickens and turkeys) or lizards
n framework consisting of stakes interwoven with branches to form a fence
n any of various Australasian trees yielding slender poles suitable for wattle
v build of or with wattle
v interlace to form wattle
wattles.translation:
n. 编条( wattle的名词复数 ); 枝条; 枝条编成的篱笆; 板条
v. 用编条做成( wattle的第三人称单数 )

wattless.definition:
n a fleshy wrinkled and often brightly colored fold of skin hanging from the neck or throat of certain birds (chickens and turkeys) or lizards
n framework consisting of stakes interwoven with branches to form a fence
n any of various Australasian trees yielding slender poles suitable for wattle

v interlace to form wattle

wattling.translation: v. 用编条做成( wattle的现在分词 )

wattmeter.definition: n. an instrument for measuring in watts the flow of power in an electrical circuit
wattmeter.translation:
n. 瓦特计
[化] 瓦特计
